Container.Name: bryce3d
Container.Overview: Bryce 3D (1997) running under Wine, usable from a web browser via noVNC. Put the Bryce 3D CD .iso (or a .zip containing it) in the storage share; it is installed automatically on first start.

Config.Name: Storage share
Config.Description: Put the Bryce ISO/zip here. Appears as drive E: inside Bryce for scenes and renders.

Config.Name: Screen width
Config.Description: Width of Bryce's screen. Fixed: the browser shows it at real size and only shrinks it if the window is too small. 640x480, 800x600 or 1024x768 suit Bryce 3D.

Config.Name: Web password
Config.Description: Set to 1 and fill in the username/password below to require a login

Config.Name: Sharp scaling
Config.Description: 1 = blocky crisp pixels when the browser scales the screen (good for a small screen enlarged by whole multiples), 0 = smooth

Config.Name: Pop-up click fix
Config.Description: 1 = keep Bryce's preset pop-ups (Objects, Materials, Sky & Fog) open on a normal click

Config.Name: Molecule converter
Config.Description: 1 = convert .sdf/.mol files dropped into the share's 'molecules' folder into .3ds/.obj models for Bryce

Config.Name: Molecule style
Config.Description: Which models to make, comma-separated: spacefill, ballstick, sticks. With more than one, files are named e.g. caffeine-ballstick.3ds

Config.Name: Molecule quality
Config.Description: Sphere smoothness: low (320 triangles per atom), medium (1,280), high (5,120), ultra (20,480)

Config.Name: Molecule hydrogens
Config.Description: 1 = include hydrogen atoms, 0 = leave them out

Config.Name: Molecule orientation
Config.Description: standard = every molecule in the same pose (longest side left-right, flattest side facing the camera); original = as in the PubChem file
